title: Multiprocessing Pipe
prompt:
Create a two-way communication pipe between parent and child processes.

Starting code:

from multiprocessing import ___

parent_conn, child_conn = Pipe()
parent_conn.send("hello")
msg = child_conn.recv()
sample_solution:

msg = child_conn.recv()

title: Asyncio TaskGroup
prompt:
Run a group of tasks with structured concurrency using asyncio.TaskGroup.

Starting code:

import asyncio

async def main():
    async with asyncio.___() as tg:
        tg.create_task(job1())
        tg.create_task(job2())
sample_solution:

async def main():
    async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as tg:
        tg.create_task(job1())
        tg.create_task(job2())

title: Async Generator Comprehension

title: Threading Barrier
prompt:
Synchronize 3 threads so they all wait until all 3 reach the barrier point.

Starting code:

from threading import Barrier

barrier = Barrier(3)

# Inside each worker thread:
barrier.___()
sample_solution:

title: CSVDictReader
prompt:
Read rows from a CSV file as dictionaries keyed by the header row.

Starting code:

import csv

with open("users_data.csv", mode="r", newline="") as f:
    reader = csv.___(f)
    for row in reader:
        print(row["name"])
sample_solution:
import csv

with open("users_data.csv", mode="r", newline="") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        print(row["name"])

title: CSVDictWriter
prompt:
Write dictionaries to a CSV file, writing the header row first.

Starting code:

import csv

with open("output_data.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["id", "name"])
    writer.___()
    writer.writerow({"id": 1, "name": "Alice"})
sample_solution:
import csv

with open("output_data.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["id", "name"])
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerow({"id": 1, "name": "Alice"})
